_note: ICT 2022 Mentorship model, written as explicit rules for NIFTY 5-minute candles. Every number here was fixed BEFORE looking at any result. Change one, rerun backtest_ict.py, and the Evidence Board re-labels it. Information only - not financial advice.
_liquidity_note: pd = previous day high/low; swing = confirmed 5m swing highs/lows made earlier today; or = opening-range high/low (first or_minutes).
_pd_filter_note: none | eq (buy only below 50% of today's range so far, sell only above) | open (buy only below today's open, sell only above). Fixed in advance as eq because six episodes stress premium/discount.
_smt_note: none | require (only setups where Bank Nifty did NOT confirm the sweep). Needs Bank Nifty 1m history: backtest_ict.py --fetch-bn 730
